note: The IFC and Arab Monetary Fund's Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015), on the Bank of Algeria's Regulation 12-01 of 20 February 2012: negative data is kept five years from the payment incident. The Bank of Algeria's own site gave no answer, so the guide is registered as secondary, quoting the regulation. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: IFC and Arab Monetary Fund, Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015)
sources.said: Regulation No. 12-01 (February 20, 2012) stipulates ... from the date of payment incident for negative data.
